classifiedFinding.title: Permissionless claim() triggers external dispatcherHook.pull(), letting any caller force mint-debt realisation on a cadence the protocol cannot rate-limit

classification.assetImpact: No asset loss to NFTStaker. Operational griefing of the dispatcher hook side: a caller with zero stake can repeatedly trigger pull() on the configured hook, denying the hook side any batching efficiency. Cost-shifting only.
attackPath: 3. Each call triggers dispatcherHook.pull(), forcing the hook to mint and zero its debt ledger immediately.
4. Hook-side gas / state-update cost amplified; NFTStaker incurs only the griefer's own gas spend.
classification.likelihood: low - griefer pays their own gas with no profit motive.
classification.assumptions: Hook side has per-call cost worth amplifying; griefer accepts gas burn.

classifiedFinding.justification: Low. Operational griefing surface with no asset impact on the in-scope contract. The permissionless refresh property is partly intentional (any user can refresh the schedule for runway accuracy). Recommendation: add a no-stake guard or accept and document the behaviour.
